description: This Java source file defines a final class 'MappedOutcome' implementing the 'MappingOutcome' interface. It encapsulates the outcome of a mapping operation, including details like mapper ID, mapped value, topic path, and an optional external message. The class provides a method 'accept' that allows a visitor to process the outcome, handling exceptions appropriately.
